text: I'm sorry to message so late, I'm looking after my grandson who is 2 and I'm in a bit of a state. He hasn't done a poo for three days now and he's been ever so grumpy about it, keeps straining and crying and pushing me away. His bottom is very sore and red with nappy rash too, poor love. His nappies are still wet so he's weeing like normal, I've been checking every time. Temperature is 37.9. I don't want to do the wrong thing while his mum's away. Can I give him anything for the poo, and what's best for the rash?
